tasks.output: {"needs":[{"challengeId":"C001-CH1","triage":"research","triageReason":"Unsupervised anomaly detection in industrial protocols with no labelled attack data is an open technical problem requiring novel methods for baseline learning and drift detection.","restatement":{"text":"ArmaturaSec has collected several terabytes of normal Modbus TCP and BACnet/IP traffic captures from client sites over three years, but no confirmed malicious traffic examples exist (C001-CH1). The company needs a method to learn what normal behaviour looks like on a specific site and flag deviations without supervised labels, and the method must be explainable to plant managers and executable on-device without affecting packet forwarding latency (C001-CH1, C001/blog/2024-05-20).","sourceIds":["C001-CH1","C001/blog/2024-05-20"]},"searchTerms":["unsupervised anomaly detection","industrial protocol traffic","baseline learning","concept drift","one-class classification","Modbus TCP","BACnet/IP","real-time inference"],"assets":[{"text":"Several terabytes of normal Modbus TCP and BACnet/IP traffic captures from consenting clients collected over three years","sourceIds":["C001-CH1"]},{"text":"Hardware to run inference on-device in the ProtoSense module","sourceIds":["C001-CH1"]},{"text":"One engineer with six months of reading on anomaly detection methods","sourceIds":["C001-CH1"]},{"text":"Embedded Linux firmware codebase with protocol parsing and access control components","sourceIds":["C001","C001/job/2024-02-05"]}],"constraints":[{"text":"Supervised classifiers trained on public ICS datasets produced unacceptable false positive rates in real deployments and were switched off by clients","sourceIds":["C001-CH1","C001/blog/2024-05-20"]},{"text":"Method must be explainable in plain language to plant managers","sourceIds":["C001-CH1"]},{"text":"Inference must run on-device without affecting packet forwarding latency","sourceIds":["C001-CH1"]},{"text":"One to two engineers available part-time with access to traffic archives, hardware bench, and firmware codebase under NDA","sourceIds":["C001"]}]},{"challengeId":"C001-CH2","triage":"engineering-service","triageReason":"Secure firmware update design over interrupted cellular links with rollback tolerance is a systems engineering problem with known solutions (signed packages, stateful download managers, atomic commit patterns); the choice is implementation and trade-offs, not a research question.","restatement":{"text":"ArmaturaSec appliances currently require on-site USB updates, and three over-the-air update approaches have each failed (plain HTTPS signature check had inadequate key storage on current hardware; dual-partition rollback left devices unrecoverable if GPRS dropped mid-transfer; download manager with resume exceeded flash budget on older variants) (C001-CH2). The company needs a design tolerating interrupted cellular transfers without new remote code execution paths and retrofittable to existing hardware.","sourceIds":["C001-CH2"]},"searchTerms":[],"assets":[{"text":"Existing GPRS and LTE-M cellular backhaul infrastructure on appliances","sourceIds":["C001"]},{"text":"X.509 certificate management and firmware codebase in C and Rust","sourceIds":["C001"]},{"text":"Hardware bench with physical boards, PLC simulators, and packet generators","sourceIds":["C001/job/2024-02-05"]},{"text":"Draft threat model document","sourceIds":["C001-CH2"]}],"constraints":[{"text":"Must tolerate interrupted GPRS transfers and recover remotely (unmanned sites cannot be physically accessed)","sourceIds":["C001-CH2"]},{"text":"Must not require hardware changes (retrofit constraint on four variants with different flash budgets)","sourceIds":["C001-CH2"]},{"text":"Must not introduce new remote code execution paths","sourceIds":["C001-CH2"]},{"text":"Monthly release cycles across four hardware variants","sourceIds":["C001-CH4"]}]},{"challengeId":"C001-CH3","triage":"not-research","triageReason":"Risk quantification methodology for procurement and board reporting is a business process and financial analysis problem, not a technical or scientific research question.","restatement":{"text":"Four clients (three in Serbia, one in Bosnia) require ArmaturaSec to quantify vulnerability risk in euros for SecAudit reports to justify remediation budgets to boards and procurement officers (C001-CH3). The company has vulnerability records, downtime cost data for utilities, and published Western European incident studies, but lacks a repeatable methodology specific to production downtime, Serbian energy law regulatory fines, and emergency response costs.","sourceIds":["C001-CH3"]},"searchTerms":[],"assets":[{"text":"Records of vulnerabilities identified in past SecAudit engagements","sourceIds":["C001-CH3"]},{"text":"Knowledge of downtime costs for water utilities and electricity distributors in the region","sourceIds":["C001-CH3"]},{"text":"Published incident cost studies from Western Europe","sourceIds":["C001-CH3"]},{"text":"Existing audit team","sourceIds":["C001-CH3"]}],"constraints":[{"text":"Two published frameworks examined were either too abstract or built for IT environments where data breach costs dominate","sourceIds":["C001-CH3"]},{"text":"Methodology must be applicable consistently across different client types (water, energy, manufacturing)","sourceIds":["C001-CH3"]},{"text":"Must survive scrutiny from procurement officers","sourceIds":["C001-CH3"]},{"text":"Must run with existing audit team without hiring a financial analyst","sourceIds":["C001-CH3"]}]},{"challengeId":"C001-CH4","triage":"engineering-service","triageReason":"Test automation and generation for firmware regression suites is a systems engineering problem; the solution is scaffolding test skeletons from protocol specifications and improving the existing Python test runner, not new research.","restatement":{"text":"ArmaturaSec's QA team manually writes and maintains approximately 1,400 regression test cases for monthly firmware releases across four hardware variants, consuming 35% of engineering time (C001-CH4). Three bugs in the past year escaped because test cases were out of date. The company needs to automatically generate test case skeletons from protocol specifications such that a junior engineer can complete a test in one hour rather than one day, using the existing Python test runner and hardware bench without replacement.","sourceIds":["C001-CH4","C001/job/2024-03-12"]},"searchTerms":[],"assets":[{"text":"Existing Python-based test runner integrated with physical hardware bench","sourceIds":["C001-CH4","C001/job/2024-03-12"]},{"text":"Internal protocol specifications for Modbus TCP, BACnet/IP, and less common industrial protocols","sourceIds":["C001/job/2024-02-05"]},{"text":"1,400 hand-written regression test cases built since 2015 as a code base to learn from","sourceIds":["C001-CH4"]},{"text":"Four hardware boards and PLC simulators on bench","sourceIds":["C001/job/2024-02-05"]}],"constraints":[{"text":"Previous attempt to generate tests from internal protocol specifications was abandoned due to brittleness","sourceIds":["C001-CH4"]},{"text":"Must fit inside existing Python-based test runner","sourceIds":["C001-CH4"]},{"text":"Must not require replacement of existing hardware bench","sourceIds":["C001-CH4"]},{"text":"Monthly release cycle across four hardware variants","sourceIds":["C001-CH4"]}]}]}

{"needs":[{"challengeId":"C003-CH1","triage":"research","triageReason":"Open technical question on the mechanism of weld failure under low-temperature cyclic loading with thermal cycling and corrosion—cannot be solved by applying existing standard procedures.","restatement":{"text":"Mild steel welded conveyor frames crack at the main crossmember-to-stringer weld joints after roughly 18 months of continuous operation at 2–6 °C in food processing cold stores (C003-CH1). The company has replaced 14 assemblies under warranty this year and cannot reproduce the failure at room temperature with static or cyclic loading, suggesting that thermal cycling, condensation, and vibration interact to cause the failure (C003-CH1). The company has photographs, measurements, and two failed frame sections available (C003-CH1).","sourceIds":["C003-CH1"]},"searchTerms":["cold-induced fatigue","thermal cycling fatigue","weld joint cracking","stress corrosion cracking","low-temperature embrittlement","vibration-induced fatigue","condensation corrosion","hollow section welding","cyclic loading at low temperature"],"assets":[{"text":"Two failed frame sections with weld cracks from customer sites, photographs, and measurements from site visits available for inspection (C003-CH1).","sourceIds":["C003-CH1"]},{"text":"In-house fabrication shop and testing floor with welding capability and 212 engineers, electricians, and technicians (C003).","sourceIds":["C003"]},{"text":"Access to customer installations operating continuously in cold stores at 2–6 °C with multiple frame assemblies in active service (C003-CH1, C003/news/2024-04-03).","sourceIds":["C003-CH1","C003/news/2024-04-03"]},{"text":"Historical data on design, welding procedure, filler material, and paint/corrosion-protection specification used in affected frames (C003-CH1).","sourceIds":["C003-CH1"]}],"constraints":[{"text":"Testing must characterise the failure mechanism at low temperature under cyclic load with thermal cycling, not at room temperature, because room-temperature testing has failed to reproduce the failure (C003-CH1).","sourceIds":["C003-CH1"]},{"text":"Solution must be implementable through changes to welding procedure, filler material, or joint design without major redesign of existing systems (C003-CH1).","sourceIds":["C003-CH1"]},{"text":"Warranty replacement costs are ongoing; the company wants to stop replacements (C003-CH1).","sourceIds":["C003-CH1"]}]},{"challengeId":"C003-CH2","triage":"engineering-service","triageReason":"A known solution exists (modular code reuse, structured programming, library-based PLC design) but requires systematic refactoring and knowledge transfer that is an engineering service, not research.","restatement":{"text":"AutomVoj maintains 38 separate PLC codebases written in ladder logic in TIA Portal for different customer installations; when pushing a safety patch, the company must touch all 38 codebases, which takes three engineers two weeks and has left two sites with logic differences (C003-CH2). The company suspects the solution is modular code reuse or a structured library, but cannot start a rewrite while the senior PLC programmer and other engineers are fully allocated to active commissioning projects (C003-CH2).","sourceIds":["C003-CH2"]},"searchTerms":[],"assets":[{"text":"38 active PLC codebases in TIA Portal across the installed base, with one senior PLC programmer (Dragan Ilić) who understands the full picture (C003-CH2).","sourceIds":["C003-CH2"]},{"text":"Three engineers available to work on code refactoring, but currently committed to commissioning projects (C003-CH2).","sourceIds":["C003-CH2"]},{"text":"Expertise in Siemens S7-1500 and S7-300 PLC platforms, ladder logic and structured text programming in TIA Portal (C003).","sourceIds":["C003"]}],"constraints":[{"text":"The solution must not require rewriting everything at once and must be maintainable by the current team going forward (C003-CH2).","sourceIds":["C003-CH2"]},{"text":"Daily project load pulls engineers away from long-term improvement work (C003-CH2).","sourceIds":["C003-CH2"]},{"text":"The company is increasing export to 55 percent of revenue within three years and evaluating poultry processing as a second vertical, which will add more installations and codebases (C003).","sourceIds":["C003"]}]},{"challengeId":"C003-CH3","triage":"not-research","triageReason":"Financial modelling and loan application preparation are business and management work, not research.","restatement":{"text":"AutomVoj needs a three-year cash-flow model with sensitivity analysis for a €2 million investment in a second assembly hall to satisfy bank lending conditions before a Q3 deadline (C003-CH3). The company has five years of audited accounts, project margin records, and a pipeline of signed and probable orders, but the CFO does not have capacity to prepare the model before the deadline (C003-CH3).","sourceIds":["C003-CH3"]},"searchTerms":[],"assets":[{"text":"Five years of audited financial accounts, project margin records, and a pipeline of signed and probable orders available (C003-CH3).","sourceIds":["C003-CH3"]},{"text":"Planning permission and cleared site adjacent to the existing building with electrical infrastructure and overhead crane planned (C003-CH3).","sourceIds":["C003-CH3"]}],"constraints":[{"text":"The bank requires the model before the Q3 deadline, which falls at the end of September 2024 (C003-CH3).","sourceIds":["C003-CH3"]},{"text":"The CFO, Milena Varga, does not have time to learn financial modelling from scratch before the deadline (C003-CH3).","sourceIds":["C003-CH3"]},{"text":"The investment is €2 million covering the building shell, electrical infrastructure, and a new overhead crane; the second assembly hall would allow running two large projects in parallel and cutting delivery lead times (C003-CH3).","sourceIds":["C003-CH3"]}]},{"challengeId":"C003-CH4","triage":"engineering-service","triageReason":"Harmonic measurement and EMC compliance is a known engineering problem with standard solutions (power quality measurement tools, harmonic analysis, filter tuning); the company needs characterisation and design rules, not research.","restatement":{"text":"Two customers of AutomVoj have reported erratic behaviour in precision measurement instruments on their production floors; the company suspects harmonic current emissions from Siemens SINAMICS frequency drives feeding back into the building's low-voltage grid (C003-CH4). The company has added line reactors to both installations and complaints have reduced but not stopped; however, it does not have test equipment to measure the emission spectrum on site, compare it to EN standards for harmonic disturbance, or identify which part of the drive configuration is most responsible (C003-CH4).","sourceIds":["C003-CH4"]},"searchTerms":["harmonic distortion","power quality measurement","frequency drive EMC","grid harmonics","conducted emissions","EN 61000-3 harmonic limits","line reactor design","variable frequency drive interference"],"assets":[{"text":"Two customer sites with active conveyor systems using SINAMICS drives; one dairy processing plant and one packaged-goods warehouse (C003-CH4).","sourceIds":["C003-CH4"]},{"text":"Siemens SINAMICS and SEW-EURODRIVE servo and frequency drive systems in use; line reactors already installed on problem sites (C003-CH4, C003).","sourceIds":["C003-CH4","C003"]},{"text":"In-house electrical assembly area and testing floor at the Zrenjanin site (C003).","sourceIds":["C003"]}],"constraints":[{"text":"Budget is limited; the company is looking for a practical engineering solution, not a research project (C003-CH4).","sourceIds":["C003-CH4"]},{"text":"The company wants a consistent design rule it can apply to new installations so the problem does not recur (C003-CH4).","sourceIds":["C003-CH4"]},{"text":"The company intends to increase export to 55 percent of revenue and enter automated poultry processing lines, which will add more frequency drive installations (C003).","sourceIds":["C003"]}]}]}

{"needs":[{"challengeId":"C004-CH1","triage":"research","triageReason":"The company faces an open technical problem: how to infer localized rainfall at individual parcels from sparse weather station networks 30 km apart, using satellite and meteorological data fusion.","restatement":{"text":"OsiguroMi's parametric crop-insurance payout is triggered by rainfall measurements from official weather stations, but the nearest station is sometimes 30 km away from a farmer's parcel (C004-CH1), and terrain variations mean the station's drought coincides with local rain on the field or vice versa. The company has access to RHMZS data and three private agro-meteorological networks, totaling about 140 measurement points across the region (C004-CH1). The goal is to calibrate payout logic by the next season based on spatially accurate rainfall estimates per parcel, without replacing the contractual threshold (C004-CH1).","sourceIds":["C004-CH1"]},"searchTerms":["spatial interpolation rainfall","weather station network bias","satellite soil moisture index","kriging microclimate","hydrometeorological data fusion","parametric insurance calibration","terrain-corrected precipitation","remote sensing agricultural drought"],"assets":[{"text":"Access to RHMZS (Serbian Hydrometeorological Service) data and data from three private agro-meteorological networks, totaling about 140 measurement points in the region.","sourceIds":["C004-CH1"]},{"text":"Feedback from farm partners in Vojvodina and Mačva regions showing payout errors correlated with distance from weather stations (C004-CH1), and integration with Polje.rs platform covering 1,200 farm parcels with known cadastral locations.","sourceIds":["C004-CH1","C004/news/2023-11-08"]},{"text":"Python environment and PostgreSQL database with historical time series for loss modeling and trigger calibration.","sourceIds":["C004"]},{"text":"One internal researcher for data modeling and two senior engineers who can dedicate part of their capacity to joint projects, with results applicable within six to nine months.","sourceIds":["C004"]}],"constraints":[{"text":"Deadline is the next crop season (April 2024); results must be implementable within the company's existing infrastructure and Kubernetes orchestration.","sourceIds":["C004-CH1","C004/news/2023-11-08"]},{"text":"The solution must not replace the contractual rainfall threshold but rather correct it through more accurate spatial estimation.","sourceIds":["C004-CH1"]},{"text":"The company is planning to expand the agro line to Bulgaria and Romania by the end of 2025 through partnerships with regional cooperatives, so the methodology must be transferable to different regional climate contexts.","sourceIds":["C004"]}]},{"challengeId":"C004-CH2","triage":"research","triageReason":"The company needs a statistical method to detect data errors in streaming flight-status feeds before triggering automatic payouts—balancing false-positive suppression against real error detection in a production system.","restatement":{"text":"OsiguroMi processes approximately 9,000 travel-delay claims monthly in full automation, but internal audit found that 3.1% of payouts were triggered by data errors from the flight-status API rather than genuine delays (C004-CH2, C004/blog/2024-01-29). Errors include duplicate records, misclassified cancellations, and incorrect timestamps from the API provider. The goal is a validation layer that assesses data credibility in real time, before the trigger fires a payout, without slowing decision-making below 60 seconds (C004-CH2, C004/blog/2024-01-29). The company has a log of about 340,000 prior API calls and payouts (C004-CH2) and operates within existing infrastructure constraints.","sourceIds":["C004-CH2","C004/blog/2024-01-29"]},"searchTerms":["anomaly detection streaming data","data quality validation API","outlier detection time series","Byzantine fault tolerance distributed data","consistency checking real-time feeds","error classification classification model","traffic pattern learning drift detection","low-latency data filtering"],"assets":[{"text":"Log of approximately 340,000 historical API calls and corresponding payout records to train detection models.","sourceIds":["C004-CH2"]},{"text":"Current single external flight-status API provider integration with full access to raw and processed feeds.","sourceIds":["C004-CH2"]},{"text":"Python environment and PostgreSQL with time-series data, plus Kubernetes orchestration for real-time processing.","sourceIds":["C004"]},{"text":"Two senior engineers available to allocate part of capacity to joint projects, with results needed within six to nine months.","sourceIds":["C004"]}],"constraints":[{"text":"Processing must complete in less than 60 seconds from API notification to user notification, because the product value depends on alerting before the passenger leaves the airport (C004-CH2, C004/blog/2024-01-29).","sourceIds":["C004-CH2","C004/blog/2024-01-29"]},{"text":"Budget is limited; the solution must operate within existing infrastructure rather than requiring new systems (C004-CH2).","sourceIds":["C004-CH2"]},{"text":"False positives must be minimized, as they would block legitimate payouts; the company tested simple rule-based anomaly detection but found it triggered too many invalid alarms (C004-CH2).","sourceIds":["C004-CH2"]}]},{"challengeId":"C004-CH3","triage":"research","triageReason":"The company faces an open statistical problem: constructing stable actuarial loss curves for parametric insurance pricing from fewer than 200 historical events when standard methods require far larger sample sizes.","restatement":{"text":"OsiguroMi is developing parametric festival-cancellation insurance triggered when weather forecasts or official ban exceed contractual thresholds (C004-CH3). Standard actuarial methods for pricing require stable loss curves, but the company's database contains fewer than 200 historical festival events with matching weather data, far below the threshold for classical methods (C004-CH3). The goal is a pricing methodology yielding reasonable confidence intervals even with small historical samples, applicable across different regional locations (C004-CH3). The actuarial team is two people and cannot build this alone.","sourceIds":["C004-CH3"]},"searchTerms":["small-sample loss distribution estimation","extreme value theory parametric insurance","Bayesian prior construction sparse data","bootstrapping confidence intervals actuarial","hierarchical modeling regional climate variation","weather extremes regional statistics","empirical uncertainty quantification limited samples","insurance pricing sparse event data"],"assets":[{"text":"Database of fewer than 200 historical festival events with corresponding weather data and cancellation outcomes.","sourceIds":["C004-CH3"]},{"text":"Access to regional meteorological data and historical weather extremes for each season and location.","sourceIds":["C004-CH3"]},{"text":"One internal researcher for data modeling and existing Python environment for actuarial modeling.","sourceIds":["C004"]},{"text":"Two-person actuarial team open to collaboration; junior actuary / analyst positions being hired with skills in Bayesian methods and extreme value theory.","sourceIds":["C004","C004/job/2024-03-05"]}],"constraints":[{"text":"Results must be applicable to multiple locations across the region, not just historical event locations.","sourceIds":["C004-CH3"]},{"text":"Pricing margins must remain competitive; overly conservative intervals would make premiums unaffordable relative to market alternatives.","sourceIds":["C004-CH3"]},{"text":"The company is planning expansion to Bulgaria and Romania by end of 2025, so methodology should generalize to other regional contexts beyond historical data.","sourceIds":["C004"]}]},{"challengeId":"C004-CH4","triage":"not-research","triageReason":"This is a regulatory and legal compliance problem requiring expert navigation of FMA (Austrian regulator) licensing procedures, not a technical or scientific research question.","restatement":{"text":"OsiguroMi signed a distribution agreement with Vienna-based travel platform ViennaJourney GmbH to launch sales in Q1 2024, but the FMA (Austrian Financial Market Authority) licensing process has stalled for seven months after the company's legal representative resigned (C004-CH4). Documentation is incomplete and FMA requires certain documents to be notarized by the person who originally filed, and the process must restart with a new representative (C004-CH4). The deadline is May 2024 when the partner plans to include the product in summer-season marketing (C004-CH4).","sourceIds":["C004-CH4"]},"searchTerms":[],"assets":[{"text":"Signed distribution agreement with ViennaJourney GmbH and existing regulatory submissions to FMA.","sourceIds":["C004-CH4"]},{"text":"New legal advisor retained to restart the FMA licensing process.","sourceIds":["C004-CH4"]}],"constraints":[{"text":"FMA licensing documentation must be completed by May 2024, or the partner will postpone product integration to the following season.","sourceIds":["C004-CH4"]},{"text":"FMA requires original notarization by the person who initially filed the application, complicating the transition after the previous representative resigned.","sourceIds":["C004-CH4"]},{"text":"The company is considering its own licensed distribution in another EU jurisdiction to reduce dependence on external intermediaries.","sourceIds":["C004"]}]}]}

{"needs":[{"challengeId":"C005-CH1","triage":"research","triageReason":"Optimizing active power consumption in a mixed-signal embedded system (radio duty cycling, ADC configuration, memory access patterns) for a medical device with hard performance constraints is an open technical problem requiring new design or measurement insights.","restatement":{"text":"The KL-Patch 72 device consumes 18 mAh per day when Bluetooth is active, limiting battery life to barely the full 72-hour wear period in active patients; researchers must find a way to cut active current draw by at least 35% while maintaining ECG sampling rate at 250 Hz or above (C005-CH1).
